title: Undergraduate and Graduate Positions EOI
location: Australia (Sippy Downs QLD listing; national projects)
content_text: Expression of interest for Graduate/Undergraduate positions at Georgiou. Tertiary Qualifications in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, HSEQ, Construction Management or related disciplines. Passion for civil construction; construction exposure advantageous but not necessary. Develop technical and non-technical skills across Engineering, Project Management and Tendering. Assist with planning, coordinating and controlling professional activities on projects. Complete predetermined competencies in the Graduate Development Program. Apply via Georgiou careers / ViewJobs listing. Cadet and Graduate Development Program handbook published on georgiou.com.au. Careers ATS: https://georgiou.csod.com/ux/ats/careersite/4/home?c=georgiou
apply_instructions: Apply via Georgiou careers portal https://georgiou.csod.com/ux/ats/careersite/4/home?c=georgiou or the ViewJobs EOI listing. Program details at https://www.georgiou.com.au/careers/cadet-graduate-programs/
